schema:name: KGRecommendationStrength
dcterms:title: Knowledge graph L1: recommendation strength
dcterms:description: GRADE strength. Strength is not certainty: a strong recommendation can rest on low-certainty evidence and a conditional one on high. Record "weak" as conditional; the handbook treats them as synonyms (§10.4). Source: smart-kg ontology/l1/l1.json valueSets "recommendation-strength"; WHO handbook for guideline development (2014) §10.4.
